blocks.text: Patha (muscle) woh tissue hai jo jism ke hisson ya poore jism ki harkat paida karne ke liye ham-aahang tareeqe se sukar sakta hai. Pathe ke alag alag cells muscle fibres ya myofibres hain. Pathon ki sukarne aur dheele hone ki salahiyat na sirf jism ko harkat deti hai balke woh quwwat bhi deti hai jo khoon aur khoorak jaise maddon ko jism mein dhakelti hai.

blocks.title: Doosre janwaron mein pathe
blocks.text: Taqreeban tamam janwar pathe istemal karte hain. Jab machhar urta hai to us ke par tezi se sukarne wale urne ke pathon se hawa mein tezi se hilte hain; jab kenchua mitti mein surang banata hai to us ki harkat mazboot pathon se chalti hai jo us ke jism ko gird ki mitti se aage dhakelte hain.
Pathon ki qismein
Insani jism mein teen qism ke muscle tissue hain: skeletal, smooth aur cardiac.

items: Skeletal pathe jism ke hisson jaise aza, dhar aur chehre ko hilate hain. In ke reshe dhaariyon (striations) wale lambe cells hain. Chunke in ka sukarna aam taur par shaoori taur par qaboo hota hai, skeletal pathe ikhtiyari (voluntary) pathe hain.

Smooth pathe maide, aanton, khoon ki naliyon aur doosre andarooni aza ki deewaron mein hote hain. In ke reshe takle (spindle) ki shakal ke hain, ek nucleus rakhte hain aur dhaariyon se khali hain, aur connective tissue se ghire hain. Chunke in ki zyada tar harkatein shaoori taur par qaboo nahin ho saktin, smooth patha ghair-ikhtiyari (involuntary) patha hai.

Cardiac pathe sirf dil ki deewaron mein hote hain. In ke reshe bohat shakhein nikalte hain aur skeletal pathe ki tarah dhaaridar hain, magar har cell mein aam taur par markaz ke qareeb ek nucleus hota hai.

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Skeletal muscle: lambe mutawazi dhaaridar (striated) reshe jin ke kinaron ke paas bohat se nuclei hain. Smooth muscle: takle (spindle) jaise cells, dhaariyon ke baghair, har ek mein beech mein ek nucleus. Cardiac muscle: shakhon wale dhaaridar reshe jo intercalated disks se sire se sira jure hain, beech mein nuclei. Labels: Striations, Nucleus, Plasma membrane, Intercalated disk.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon ko teen nishanion se pehchanein: dhaariyan (skeletal aur cardiac mein, smooth mein nahin), nuclei ki tadaad aur jagah (skeletal mein bohat aur kinare par, baqi mein ek aur beech mein), aur intercalated disks (sirf cardiac mein), jo dil ke cells ko ek saath sukarne dete hain. Kitab saath khurdbeen ki tasveerein bhi chhapti hai; woh yahan nahin bani.

blocks.text: Skeletal pathon ki banawat

Skeletal pathe ke cells, muscle fibres, collagen reshon aur connective tissue mein band guchhon mein tarteeb diye hain. Pathe ke siron par collagen aur connective tissue tendons banate hain, jo pathe ko haddiyon se jorte hain.
Skeletal pathon ki ultrastructure

Har skeletal muscle fibre ek cylindrical kai-nuclei wala cell hai jo ek plasma membrane, sarcolemma, mein band hai. Is ka cytoplasm sarcoplasm hai aur is mein sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) hai. Sarcolemma cell ke andar gehrai tak ja kar khokhli lambi naliyan, transverse tubules (T-tubules), banati hai, jo SR ke siron tak pohnchti hain. Har reshe mein 4 se 20 lambe dhaage jaise myofibrils ka guchha hai, jo do qism ke filaments ke bane hain: myosin ke mote filaments aur actin ke patle filaments. Mote filaments gehri pattiyan, A-bands, banate hain aur patle filaments halki pattiyan, I-bands; yeh baari baari gehri aur halki pattiyan skeletal pathe ko us ki dhaaridar (striated) shakal deti hain.

Patle actin filaments protein ki discs, Z-lines, se jure hain. Do Z-lines ke darmiyan ka hissa sarcomere hai, pathe ke sukar ki sab se chhoti ikai. Sarcomere ke andar patle filaments Z-line se markaz ki taraf phailte hain, jahan woh mote filaments par charhte (overlap) hain; yeh overlap A-band banata hai, jis ke markaz mein halka hissa, H-band, hai jahan koi overlap nahin. Sukar ke dauran patle filaments A-band mein gehre sarakte hain, to H-band aur I-band tang hote hain aur A-bands qareeb khinchte hain, jo pathe ko chhota karta hai. H-band ke markaz mein ek gehri lakeer, M line, ho sakti hai jo mote filaments ko mustahkam rakhne mein madad deti hai. Khulasa yeh ke skeletal patha cells ke girohon, muscle fibres, ka bana hai; har reshe ke cytoplasm mein myofibrils ke guchhe hain; aur har myofibril do qism ke myofilaments, myosin aur actin, ki bani hai.

blocks.alt: Ek skeletal patha jo tendon se haddi se jura hai; us ke kate sire par muscle fibres ka guchha (bundle). Ek muscle fibre (ek cell) bara bana hai, myofibrils ke gird sarcolemma aur sarcoplasmic reticulum ke saath; ek chhota khaaka dikhata hai ke sarcolemma T-tubules banata hai. Pattiyon wala myofibril jis par sarcomere aur actin aur myosin myofilaments nishan zada hain; teer ek sarcomere tak jata hai jis mein H zone, I band, A band, I band, Z lines, myosin aur actin hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.20: Skeletal patthe ki ultrastructure (kitab ki Figure 12.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bare se chhote ki taraf chalein: patha, phir reshon ka guchha, phir ek resha (cell), phir myofibril, phir sarcomere, phir filaments. Sarcomere mein A band mote myosin ki lambai hai, I band sirf patle actin ka hissa, aur H zone beech ka woh hissa jahan sirf myosin hai. Do Z lines ke darmiyan ek sarcomere hai.
Myofilaments ki biochemistry

Mote myofilaments, qareeb 16 nm qutr ke, bohat se myosin proteins ke bane hain. Har myosin protein do guthi hui polypeptide chains par mushtamil hai jo ek golai-dar sar (head) par khatm hoti hain; yeh sar mote filament se nikalte hain aur sukar ke dauran actin se jurte hain. Patle myofilaments, 7 se 8 nm qutr ke, teen proteins ke bane hain: markaz actin ki do guthi hui lariyan hai; tropomyosin ki do lariyan actin ke markaz ke gird lipat kar use sakht karti hain, aur dheele reshe mein actin par myosin ke jurne ki jagahein band rakhti hain; aur troponin, jo ba-qaida waqfon par maujood hai, teen polypeptides ka bana hai, ek rokne wala jo actin se jurta hai, doosra tropomyosin ko jagah par rakhne ke liye us se jurta hai, aur teesra calcium ions se jurta hai.

blocks.alt: Upar: myosin filament jis ke dono hisson se bohat se heads nikle hain. Teer ek myosin molecule tak jata hai: do guthi hui polypeptides jo do heads par khatam hoti hain. Neeche: actin filament jo actin ke daanon ki do bal khayi ladiyon ka hai, us ke saath lipte tropomyosin ke dhaage aur barabar faslon par troponin. blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mota filament bohat se myosin molecules ka bana hai; har molecule ke heads hi baad mein actin ko pakar kar cross-bridges banate hain. Patle filament mein tropomyosin dheele pathe mein actin par myosin ke jurne ki jaghein dhanp deta hai, aur troponin us ko apni jagah thame rakhta hai jab tak calcium na aaye.
Pathe ke sukar ka mechanism: sliding filament model
Sliding filament model samjhata hai ke patha kaise sukarta hai: patle myofilaments mote filaments ke paas se sarakte hain taake woh zyada had tak overlap karein. Yeh in qadmon mein hota hai.

blocks.alt: Do sarcomeres. Relaxed: har sire ki Z line se actin filaments sirf kuch andar tak aate hain, aur myosin filaments ke beech chaura H-zone rehta hai; myosin ke heads cross-bridges banate hain. Contracted: actin filaments myosin par aur aage sarak gaye hain, Z lines qareeb aa gayi hain (teer) aur H-zone tang hai; myosin filaments ki lambai wahi hai. Labels: Actin filaments, H-zone, Myosin filament, Z line, Cross-bridges.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.22: Pathe ke sukarne ka sliding filament model (kitab ki Figure 12.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono halaton mein myosin aur actin ki lambai barabar hai; sirf un ka overlap barhta hai. Is liye sukarne par Z lines qareeb aati hain aur H-zone (sirf myosin wala hissa) tang ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein label 'Corss-bridges' chhapa hai; sahih hijje Cross-bridges hain, jo yahan likhe gaye hain.

items: Dheeli halat mein sarcomeres: dheele pathe mein sarcomeres apni mamool ki lambai par hain. Myosin ke sar actin se nahin jure kyunke actin par jurne ki jagahein patle filaments ke tropomyosin se band hain; troponin tropomyosin se jura hai. Myosin ke saron ne ATP ko ADP aur Pi mein hydrolyse kar rakha hai.

Aasabi impulse ka aana: jab aasabi impulse sarcolemma tak pohnchta hai to motor neuron synapse par ek neurotransmitter, acetylcholine, chhorta hai, jo sarcolemma ko apne barqi-kimiyai impulses banane par ubharta hai. Yeh T-tubules ke raste reshe ke andar sarcoplasmic reticulum tak jate hain, jo cytosol mein calcium ions chhorta hai. Calcium ions troponin se jurte hain, jo tropomyosin ko actin par myosin ke jurne ki jagahon se hata deta hai.

Cross-bridges aur power stroke: jab jurne ki jagahein khul jati hain to myosin ke sar un se jur kar cross-bridges banate hain. Phir sar ADP aur Pi chhor kar shakal badalte hain, sarcomere ke markaz ki taraf jhukte aur actin filaments ko apne saath kheenchte hain; yeh kheenchne ka amal power stroke hai. Yeh sarcomere ko chhota karta hai, Z-lines ko qareeb lata hai, aur H-zone ghaib ho jata hai. Yeh tamam sarcomeres mein ek saath hota hai, to patha sukarta hai; mutasil A-bands ek doosre ke qareeb aate hain magar chhote nahin hote.

Myosin ke saron ka actin se alag hona: kheenchne ke baad myosin ke sar ko ATP ka naya molecule milta hai, jo use actin se alag hone deta hai. Is ATP ka ADP aur Pi mein tootna sar ko us ki asal shakal mein wapas laata hai, to cross-bridge cycle dobara shuru ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Ghari ki suiyon ki simt chaar marhale, surkh teeron se jure, har ek mein mote filament ke upar patla filament aur notes. Upar: actin par binding sites band; myosin head ke paas ADP aur P. Daen: Ca ions troponin se jurte hain, sites khul jati hain aur head jur jata hai (cross-bridge). Neeche: power stroke, head ADP aur P chhor kar actin ko beech ki taraf kheenchta hai (teer). Baen: ATP head se jurta hai aur head actin se alag ho jata hai.
blocks.caption: Fig. 12.23: Power-stroke ke marhale (cross bridge cycle) (kitab ki Figure 12.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se shuru karein aur surkh teeron ke saath chalein. Calcium troponin ko hilata hai, troponin tropomyosin ko sites se hata deta hai, head jur kar jhukta hai (power stroke) aur actin ko kheenchta hai. Naya ATP head ko chhurata hai aur us ka toot kar ADP aur P banna head ko dobara tayyar kar deta hai. ATP na ho to head jura reh jata hai (rigor mortis).

blocks.title: Rigor mortis
blocks.text: Maut ke baad cells ATP nahin bana sakte, to cross-bridges toot nahin sakte; yeh maut ki pathon ki akran, rigor mortis, karta hai. Zinda cell mein hamesha itna ATP hota hai ke myosin ke sar actin se alag ho saken.
Hilne wale joron par skeletal pathon ki tarteeb

Skeletal pathe sakht connective tissues, tendons, se haddiyon se jure hain. Aam taur par pathe ke mukhtalif haddiyon par do jurne ke nuqte hote hain: sukar ke dauran sakin rehne wali haddi se jura sira origin hai, aur hilne wali haddi se jura sira insertion; pathe ka darmiyani hissa belly hai. Jor par haddiyon ki do simton mein harkat ke liye pathe joron mein kaam karte hain jo sukar kar mukhalif amal karte hain, antagonistic tarteeb. Jab ek patha, flexor, sukarta hai to jor par haddi ko morta hai; jab mukhalif patha, extensor, sukarta hai to haddi ko seedha karta hai. Aisi antagonistic harkat mein jab flexor sukarta hai to extensor dheela hota hai, aur is ke bar-aks.

blocks.alt: Bazu ki haddiyan pehlu se: scapula, humerus, aur mure hue bazu ki radius aur ulna. Biceps humerus ke aage scapula par apne origins se, belly se guzar kar, tendon ke zariye radius par insertion tak jata hai; triceps humerus ke peechhe apne origins se kohni ke peechhe ulna par insertion tak. Teer flexion (upar) aur extension (neeche) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.24: Kohni ke jor par skeletal pathon ki tarteeb (kitab ki Figure 12.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Origin woh sira hai jo na hilne wali haddi (scapula) se jura hai, insertion woh jo hilne wali haddi se. Biceps sukarta hai to radius ko upar kheench kar kohni morta hai (flexion); triceps sukarta hai to ulna ko kheench kar bazu seedha karta hai (extension). Ek sukarta hai to doosra dheela parta hai: yeh antagonistic jora hai.
Ghutne ke jor par harkat

Ghutne ka jor femur (raan ki haddi) aur tibia aur fibula (nichli taang ki haddiyan) ke darmiyan hai. Nichli taang ka flexion, ya murna, hamstrings karte hain, raan ke peeche teen pathon ka giroh, jo pelvic girdle aur femur ke oopar se shuru ho kar fibula aur tibia ke oopri hisson par jurte hain. Extension, ya seedha hona, quadriceps karte hain, raan ke samne chaar pathon ka giroh, jo ilium (pelvic girdle ka hissa) aur femur se shuru ho kar patella (ghutne ki chapni) aur tibia par jurte hain. Jab hamstrings sukarte hain to nichli taang murti hai aur quadriceps dheele hote hain; jab quadriceps sukarte hain to nichli taang seedhi hoti hai aur hamstrings dheele hote hain.

blocks.alt: Pehlu se do taangein. Baen: raan ke peechhe hamstrings sukarte hain aur nichli taang peechhe mur jati hai (flexed); dheele quadriceps nahin dikhaye gaye. Daen: raan ke aage quadriceps patella ke zariye kheench kar sukarte hain aur nichli taang seedhi ho jati hai (extended); dheele hamstrings nahin dikhaye gaye.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.25: Ghutne ke jor par harkat (kitab ki Figure 12.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har taang mein sirf sukarne wala patha dikhaya gaya hai, jaisa kitab mein hai. Hamstrings peechhe se kheench kar ghutna morte hain; quadriceps aage se patella ke zariye kheench kar ghutna seedha karte hain. Yeh bhi ek antagonistic jora hai.

blocks.title: Pathe kheenchte hain, aur skeleton levers ka nizam hai
blocks.text: Pathe sirf kheench sakte hain, dhakel nahin, kyunke muscle fibres sukar kar chhote hote hain, tendons ko kheench kar haddiyan hilate hain; jab patha dheela hota hai to haddi wapas jati hai. Dhakelne ke liye pathe ko dono siron se jura hona aur dono siron ko qareeb lana parta, jo mumkin nahin. Skeleton chharon (rods) aur levers ke nizam ki tarah kaam karta hai: haddiyan chharein hain, jo banawat aur sahara deti aur aza ki hifazat karti hain; jor fulcrums hain; pathe quwwat (effort) dete hain; aur hilaya jane wala wazan load hai. Wazan uthate waqt kohni ka jor fulcrum hai, biceps effort deta hai aur wazan load hai.
Pathon ke amraz

items: Muscle fatigue (thakan) tawil ya shadeed jismani sargarmi ke baad ya beemari se pathe ki karkardagi mein kami hai; is ki alamat dard, kam taqat aur kam bardasht hain. Yeh is liye hoti hai ke sukar ke liye istemal hone wala ATP khatm ho jata hai to patha sukar nahin sakta; kaam karte pathe lactate, hydrogen ions aur reactive oxygen jaise metabolic fuzle banate hain; baar baar faal reshe calcium ions ko kam moassar taur par sambhalte hain; aur tawil ya shadeed warzish reshon ko thora nuqsan pohncha kar soozish karti hai. Yeh aam taur par aaram se behtar hoti hai, aur shadeed thakan ko tibbi tawajjo chahiye.

Muscle cramps (ainthan) ek pathe ya pathon ke giroh ke achanak, ghair-ikhtiyari aur aksar dardnak sukar hain, jo chand seconds se kai minute tak rehte hain, aksar taangon aur pairon mein. Asbab mein pani ki kami, namak ka adam-tawazun, pathe ka zyada istemal ya chot, diuretics jaisi kuch dawaein, aur diabetes, jigar ki beemari aur asaab ke nuqsan jaisi kaifiyat shamil hain. Pathe ko aahista kheenchna aur malish karna, garmi ya thandak lagana aur dard-kush dawa inhen door karte hain.

Tetany pathon ke barhe hue tanao (tone) aur asaab ki hyperexcitability se ghair-ikhtiyari sukar ya ainthan hai, haathon, pairon, chehre ya larynx mein. Is ka sab se aam sabab hypocalcaemia (khoon mein calcium ki kam satah) hai, jo vitamin D ki kami, gurde ki nakami ya thyroid ke amraz se ho sakti hai; yeh doosre namak ke adam-tawazun jaise kam magnesium se bhi ho sakti hai. Ilaj sabab par munhasir hai: namak ke adam-tawazun ke liye calcium ya magnesium ke supplements ya intravenous mayah electrolyte tawazun bahal karte hain.

blocks.caption: Tetany aur tetanus
rows: Barha hua pathon ka tanao aur zyada faal asaab jo ghair-ikhtiyari sukar ya ainthan karte hain
Clostridium tetani ka shadeed bacterial infection, jis ka zehr aasabi nizam par asar dal kar akran aur ainthan karta hai
Zyada tar jabre aur gardan ke pathe
Electrolyte ka adam-tawazun (kam calcium ya magnesium) ya asaab ke masail
Zyada sangeen aur mumkina taur par jan-lewa

blocks.prompt: Ek daurne wale ki pindli ke pathe daur ke aakhir mein jawab de dete hain, aur kam khoon ke calcium wale mareez ko haathon ki ainthan hoti hai. Har ek ko cross-bridge cycle mein ATP aur calcium ke kirdar se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Daurne wale ka patha thaka hua hai: us ka ATP khatm ho gaya hai, lactate jaise metabolic fuzle jama ho gaye hain aur reshe calcium ko kam achhi tarah sambhalte hain, to myosin ke sar cycle jari nahin rakh sakte aur patha zor se sukar nahin sakta; aaram use bahal karta hai. Mareez mein kam calcium asaab ko hyperexcitable banata aur pathon ka tanao barhata hai, to reshe tetany mein ghair-ikhtiyari taur par sukarte hain; calcium ke supplements ya intravenous mayah tawazun bahal karte hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Teen muscle tissues: skeletal (dhaaridar, kai nuclei, ikhtiyari, skeleton hilata hai), smooth (takla, ek nucleus, bina dhaari, ghair-ikhtiyari, khokhle aza), cardiac (shakhdar, dhaaridar, ek nucleus, ghair-ikhtiyari, dil).

Ek resha: T-tubules wala sarcolemma, sarcoplasmic reticulum wala sarcoplasm, mote myosin aur patle actin filaments ki 4-20 myofibrils; Z line se Z line tak sarcomere I bands, A band, H zone aur M line ke saath. Mota filament: saron wala myosin; patla: actin, tropomyosin, troponin.

Sliding filament model: SR ka calcium troponin se jurta hai, tropomyosin hatta hai, sar cross-bridges banate hain, power stroke actin ko andar kheenchta hai, ATP saron ko alag karta hai; maut ke baad ATP na ho to rigor mortis.
Pathe sirf kheenchte hain, origin se insertion tak antagonistic joron mein: kohni par biceps aur triceps, ghutne par hamstrings (morna) aur quadriceps (seedha karna); skeleton levers ka nizam hai.

Thakan (ATP khatm, fuzle, calcium sambhalna, reshon ka nuqsan), ainthan (pani ki kami, namak ka adam-tawazun, zyada istemal, dawaein, beemari) aur tetany (kam calcium ya magnesium); tetanus jabre aur gardan ka Clostridium tetani infection hai.
